purpose: Demo personas based on publicly visible professional metadata from the six user-supplied profile URLs.
disclosure: These people are not registered ConferenceOS users or confirmed GitHub Universe attendees. Public profile data may be incomplete or stale. Demo interests, recommendations, event participation and graph relationships are synthetic unless separately identified as public professional evidence.
collectionMethod: Public web search index and public first-party pages only. No authenticated LinkedIn access or authentication bypass. Direct LinkedIn fetches were attempted twice and returned HTTP 999 or cache-miss errors; indexed public content supplied the professional metadata.
